# All The Smoke BBQ & Catering

> Chicagoland Premier Live-Fire Smoker & Artisan Smokehouse Catering led by Master Pitmaster Marion Bolden ("Mr. Smoke").

## Brand & Contact
- **Legal Operator**: Marion Bolden
- **Location**: Chicago's Northwest Side, Chicago, IL 60634
- **Service Area**: Chicagoland, Cook County, & Northwest Suburbs
- **Phone**: (773) 707-9988
- **Email**: info@allthesmokecatering.com
- **Website**: https://allthesmokecatering.com/
- **TikTok**: https://www.tiktok.com/@allthesmokebbq_catering
- **Hours**: Tuesday – Sunday (48–72 hours advance notice required for live-fire catering & whole smoked meats)

## Core Offerings
- **Per-Person Smokehouse Buffet Catering** (https://allthesmokecatering.com/catering/per-person/): Full-service smoked Texas brisket, St. Louis ribs, chicken, pulled pork, and scratch-made Southern sides starting at $24.95/person.
- **Turnkey BBQ Party Pans & Drop-Offs** (https://allthesmokecatering.com/catering/party-pans/): Ready-to-serve hot foil pans for game days, office lunches, and backyard gatherings starting at $285 flat.
- **Weekly Smoked Meal Prep** (https://allthesmokecatering.com/catering/meal-prep/): Vacuum-sealed hardwood-smoked lean meats and clean sides starting at $15.62/meal.
- **Weekly Smoker Chalkboard Specials** (https://allthesmokecatering.com/specials/): Rotating pitmaster specialties including Double-Smoked Burnt Ends, Cedar-Plank Salmon, Brisket Chili, and Habanero Cheddar Cornbread.
